The remaining static matches are predominantly media-tool operations, documented configuration, relative links, or test fixtures; no prompt injection or credential-exfiltration intent was found. Static review was capped at 400/2029 representative findings; omitted static matches are unconfirmed, so automatic publishing stays disabled until manual review.

remediation.suggestion: Manually review the omitted 1629 static analyzer matches or reduce bundled generated/vendor/reference content before enabling automatic publication.

remediation.suggestion: Provide a version-pinned release artifact with a published checksum or signature. Instruct users to download, inspect, verify, and then execute the installer.

content.user_title: Create and manage project media assets
content.value_statement: Media work often requires separate tools for audio, images, captions, and asset tracking. This skill provides a unified workflow that resolves or generates assets and records them locally.
actual_capabilities: Resolves background music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voices, grades, and LUTs into local project assets.
Generates voiceovers and supports transcription, captions, and background-removal workflows.
Registers resolved assets in local manifests for repeatable reuse across projects.
Provides media operations guidance for cuts, reframing, transforms, loudness, and audio ducking.
Uses configured HeyGen services and optional local providers when available.
limitations: Requires supported provider credentials or installed local tools for generation features.
The recommended setup currently includes a remote installer command that should be verified before execution.
Generated assets and provider availability depend on the selected service and account permissions.
Media recommendations require a concrete project signal and do not replace editorial approval.

use_cases.title: Prepare a video soundtrack
use_cases.description: Resolve music and sound effects, then use the audio workflow for voiceover and loudness preparation.

use_cases.title: Build a branded presentation
use_cases.description: Find logos, icons, images, and color grades and keep their local asset records organized.

use_cases.title: Automate media handoff
use_cases.description: Generate or resolve project media and return stable local paths for a production workflow.

prompt_templates.title: Find background music
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve background music for a 30-second product launch video. Use an upbeat and modern style.

prompt_templates.title: Add sound effects
prompt_templates.prompt: Review this project for scene transitions that need sound effects. Propose one consolidated list and wait for approval.

prompt_templates.title: Create a voiceover workflow
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a voiceover from this script, generate captions, and return the local asset paths and required provider setup.

prompt_templates.title: Prepare reusable media assets
prompt_templates.prompt: Resolve a logo, icons, background music, and a color grade for this project. Register each approved asset for reuse.

output_examples.input: Resolve music for an upbeat product launch video.
output: A matching background music asset is selected.
A local project path and asset identifier are returned.
The asset is registered for later reuse.

output_examples.input: Create a voiceover and captions from this script.
output: The workflow identifies the available voice provider.
A voiceover path and caption output are produced when the provider succeeds.
The result lists any missing setup requirements.

best_practices: Verify downloaded installers with a published checksum or signature before running them.
Keep provider credentials in approved environment variables or credential stores, not in project files.
Review suggested media changes before applying them to preserve editorial control.
anti_patterns: Do not run remote shell installers without reviewing and verifying the downloaded content.
Do not assume generation works without checking provider credentials, quotas, and local dependencies.
Do not silently apply media recommendations to a project without user approval.

faq.question: What media can this skill manage?
faq.answer: It can manage music, sound effects, images, icons, logos, voices, captions, color grades, and LUTs.

faq.question: Does it require an online account?
faq.answer: Some provider features require credentials. Local alternatives may be available for selected tasks.

faq.question: Can it generate voiceovers?
faq.answer: Yes. It supports text-to-speech workflows when a supported provider or local tool is configured.

faq.question: Where are assets stored?
faq.answer: Resolved assets are stored in local project media directories and can be recorded for reuse.

faq.question: Does it modify media automatically?
faq.answer: It should propose media improvements and wait for approval before applying changes.

faq.question: How should I install the required CLI?
faq.answer: Prefer a version-pinned download with a published checksum or signature. Verify it before execution.
